post.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information (name, company, profile picture).

put.description: Updates an agent using merge semantics — only the fields you include in the request body are changed; omitted fields keep their stored values. Voice and language settings are resolved from the voice catalog when `AtlasVoiceId` or `VoiceId` is provided.

post.description:
Creates a new agent for the campaign using server-managed voice and agent-type templates. Unlike `POST /agent/{campaignId}`, this endpoint resolves voice settings and scripts from template IDs rather than requiring inline configuration.

Required fields:

- `Name` — display name for the agent (always required).
- `VoiceId` — ID of the voice template (always required; defines TTS provider, language, and voice settings).

`agentTypeId` — ID of the agent-type template (defines scripts and conversational behavior) — is optional. When it is **omitted**, `AgentTypeName`, `PreScript`, and `PostScript` become required instead.

On success returns `200` with `{ campaignId, assistantId }`.

### Available `VoiceId` values

Pick the `ID` column value for the voice you want. These are Atlas catalog IDs — they are not the underlying provider's voice IDs, and the two are interchangeable only by coincidence. A voice that speaks more than one language per call has its own entry under **Multilanguage** with a different ID from its single-language entry.

Creates a campaign of one of four types: outbound phone, inbound phone,
voice bubble (web), or Messages/SMS. The channel is set via the
combination of `campaignType`, `CallType`, `MessagesCampaign`, and
`Position`:

> **Next step — create an agent.** A campaign on its own is just the
> shell (channel, language, phone numbers, schedule). The voice,
> scripts, model, and conversational behavior all live on an **agent**
> attached to the campaign. After this request returns the campaign
> ID, call `POST /agent/new/{campaignId}` (template-driven) or
> `POST /agent/{campaignId}` (inline configuration) to attach an
> agent. Without an agent, the campaign cannot place or receive
> calls/messages.


| Campaign type      | `campaignType` | `CallType` | `MessagesCampaign` | `Position` |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ---------- | ------------------ | ---------- |
| Outbound phone     | `"1"`          | `"2"`      | omit               | omit |
| Inbound phone      | `"1"`          | `"1"`      | omit               | omit |
| Voice bubble (web) | `"0"`          | omit       | omit               | `"bottom-right"` \| `"bottom-left"` \| `"bottom-center"` \| `"not-positioned"` |
| Messages / SMS     | `"0"`          | omit       | `true`             | omit |

CallRecordBasicEndedReason.description:
Reason the call ended. Common values grouped by category:

**Agent-initiated outcomes:**
`assistant-ended-call` — Agent ended the call normally.
`assistant-ended-call-after-message-spoken` — Agent delivered its final message.
`assistant-forwarded-call` — Call was transferred to another number.
`assistant-said-end-call-phrase` — Agent detected a goodbye phrase.

**Customer actions:**
`customer-ended-call` — Customer hung up.
`customer-busy` — Line was busy.
`customer-did-not-answer` — No answer from the customer.

**Technical / connection issues:**
`phone-call-provider-closed-websocket` — Connection lost.
`twilio-failed-to-connect-call` — Twilio failed to connect.
`twilio-reported-customer-misdialed` — Invalid phone number.
`server-shutdown` — Voice service replica was drained (e.g. for a deploy or scale-down) and the call did not complete before the drain deadline.

**Duration / timeout:**
`exceeded-max-duration` — Call hit the maximum duration limit.
`silence-timed-out` — Call ended after extended silence (default 30s).
`voicemail` — Call was routed to voicemail.

**Other:**
`manually-canceled` — Call was manually canceled.
`pipeline-error` — AI processing error occurred.
